svg.title: Yaman Obiedat | AI systems engineer
svg.desc: A dark blue editorial profile with an animated evidence pipeline, capabilities, sixteen technology logos, twelve projects, and RegTech architecture. Project images are labeled conceptual diagrams. Full text and links are in the README.

g.text: What makes an AI answer trustworthy?
A traceable source. A check against the evidence.
And a clear limit when the data cannot support an answer.
Building bilingual systems across AI, geospatial intelligence, and computer vision.
Amman, Jordan · Yarmouk University · HTU / 9xAI Program
Evidence-aware agents, Arabic NLP, and retrieval over structured data.
Road-network analysis, street-name resolution, and corridor routing.
Vehicle detection, multi-object tracking, and calibrated traffic analysis.
APIs, relational data, and interfaces designed for Arabic and English.
Turn citizen feedback into an investigation.
Built deep root-cause orchestration, custom agents, and evidence checks.
Connected SOP retrieval, citizen surveys, and sector-scoped workflows.
Improved Arabic PDF reports and the server-side insight review queue.
Explore how a crisis could affect Jordan.
Built the Agent Council swarm and PostgreSQL database foundation.
Redesigned bilingual screens and connected them to live APIs.
Added research-backed debate, human review, and executive reporting.
Make enrolment and learning analytics dependable.
Built enrolment APIs, capability checks, and bilingual management UI.
Handled cohort membership and role-preserving enrolment changes.
Implemented idempotent video-event ingest and watch-quality metrics.
Jordanian law search, a Legal Twin explorer, bilingual assistance,
